publish.description: Voice-to-text dictation for Game Mode. Click into any text box, hold both back paddles (L4 + R4) together for two seconds, then speak — your voice is turned into text and typed in for you. Perfect for game chat like World of Warcraft, or any chat room where you'd rather not stop to use a keyboard. A Quick Access Menu toggle is included too. Fully offline (Vosk speech recognition) — no cloud, no account.
